how_measured: The prefix holds exactly two objects; both were downloaded whole (36 KB) and opened. 30508-1.zip carries LART_LMISZONE.csv (1,270 code rows, EUC-KR, parent pointers); 30508-2.xlsx is a spreadsheet rendering of the same table that no loader reads.
why_this_file_exists: The exporter that converts the code table and the loader that reads its handoff must derive the same names from one place. The .xlsx sibling is a named exclusion: loading both would state the same fact twice in two formats (root ADR-0083).
handoff_prefix_reason: Where the converted handoff lives — declared once here so the exporter and the loader cannot drift apart.
handoff_suffix_reason: The converter names the object and the loader must derive the same name; .gz also tells the converter to compress and Spark to decompress.

excluded_objects.reason: spreadsheet rendering of the same table; not machine-loadable by this lane
